{{Youmayd|the Sabacc hand|the phrase "Idiot's Array"|[[Idiot's Array (disambiguation)]]}}
[[File:Idiots_Array_TJoY.png|thumb|right|200px|An Idiot's Array]]
An '''Idiot's Array''' was a rare hand that could be achieved in some versions of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]]. It consisted of [[The Idiot/Legends|The Idiot]], a two of any suit, and a three of the same suit (though in some versions, the two and three were not required to be suited). Rather than being added together, which under normal sabacc rules would give a total of five (2 + 3 plus the Idiot's value of zero), it was read as 23. An Idiot's Array trumped even [[Pure Sabacc/Legends|Pure Sabacc]] (a score of positive or negative 23).

[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] won the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Vuffi Raa]] with an Idiot's Array in a sabacc game on [[Oseon 2795]].<ref name="Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]''</ref>

[[Vuffi Raa]] explained the Idiot's Array to [[Waywa Fybot]] during a journey through the [[Oseon system/Legends|Oseon system]], while attempting to teach the avian [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] officer how to play sabacc. Fybot decried the Idiot's Array as "ridiculous."<ref name="Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]''</ref>

Two Idiot's Arrays were seen in the game that [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], known as Dessel at the time, played against a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] soldier, an Ensign, while he was still on Apatros some time before he joined the [[Fist of the Empire (group)|Sith Army]]. [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] won this game of sabacc in sudden demise with an Idiot's Array hand of 2, 3, the Idiot, nine, and nine.

There could be only two Idiot's Arrays, because there were only two Idiots in the deck.
